# Setup

```{python}
import sims
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from matplotlib.pyplot import figure
import cv2
```

# Import sims image


```{python}
s = sims.SIMS("data/nanoSIMS_example_images/BA4A-270-BIC_1.im")
s.data
```

align the data using `sims.utils.align()` function


```{python}
s.data.loc['12C', 0]
aligned_data, shifts = sims.utils.align(s)
```

pull out single ion layer and convert to np array


```{python}
aligned_12C = aligned_data.loc['12C'].to_numpy()
aligned_12C
np.shape(aligned_12C)
```

remove outer pixels that suffer from edge effects


```{python}
crop_margin = 20 # define the cropping dimensions
trimmed_12C = aligned_12C[:, crop_margin:-crop_margin, crop_margin:-crop_margin].squeeze()
trimmed_12C = np.mean(trimmed_12C, axis = 0)

np.shape(trimmed_12C)
```

plot 12C


```{python}
fig1, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 6))
plt.imshow(trimmed_12C)
im1 = ax1.imshow(trimmed_12C, cmap="viridis")
cbar1 = plt.colorbar(im1, ax=ax1, fraction=0.046, pad=0.04, label="12C")
plt.axis([0, 472, 0, 472])
plt.plot()
plt.show()
plt.savefig("fig_output/BA4A_270_BIC_1_12C.png", dpi=300)
```

do the same for 13C


```{python}
s.data.loc["13C", 0]
aligned_data, shifts = sims.utils.align(s)
aligned_13C = aligned_data.loc['13C'].to_numpy()
trimmed_13C = aligned_13C[:, crop_margin:-crop_margin, crop_margin:-crop_margin].squeeze()
trimmed_13C = np.mean(trimmed_13C, axis = 0)

np.shape(trimmed_13C)
```

```{python}
fig1, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 6))

```

```{python}
frac_13Cx12C = (trimmed_13C / (trimmed_12C + trimmed_13C))
```

roi

```{python}
# Read image (OpenCV loads images in BGR format)
roi_array = cv2.imread("data/nanoSIMS_example_images/BA4A-270-BIC_1_ROI.png")[:, :, 2]
roi_array = np.fliplr(roi_array)
roi_array = roi_array[crop_margin:-crop_margin, crop_margin:-crop_margin].squeeze()
binary_array = roi_array > 1

fig1, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 6))
plt.imshow(binary_array)
im1 = ax1.imshow(binary_array, cmap="gray")
cbar1 = plt.colorbar(im1, ax=ax1, fraction=0.046, pad=0.04, label="ROI")
# plt.axis([0, 472, 0, 472])
plt.plot()
plt.show()
plt.savefig("fig_output/BA4A_270_BIC_1_ROI.png", dpi=300)
```
